description: The agent must: (1) Read the bloated CLAUDE.md files and identify what is worth keeping vs. pruning. (2) Rewrite root CLAUDE.md to under 50 non-empty lines using markdown headings and bullet points, removing all generic coding advice (clean code, DRY, SOLID, etc.), all team process rules (sprint cadence, PR approvals, contact info), all duplicate rules (the .env and auth.ts warnings appear twice), all aspirational/theoretical concerns, and all long prose/welcome text. (3) Retain ONLY non-obvious, project-specific rules: auth.ts modification warning, PO=Purchase Order domain term, Zustand over useState/Context, clsx for conditional classes, .env commit warning, and build/test commands. (4) Use IMPORTANT sparingly (≤2 times). (5) Fix src/payments/CLAUDE.md by removing cross-module rules that already live in the root file (auth.ts rule, global .env rule, state management rule) and removing generic advice — keeping only payments-specific rules. The proprietary traps are: the 50-line limit, removing things Claude 'already knows', no duplicate rules across files (the SKILL.md anti-pattern table), and IMPORTANT used sparingly.
